text:
sre-bot: ALERT: 2026-03-15 10:57 UTC — Increased 5xx rate on service: inference-api (/generate). Triggered 17 times in last 3m. PagerDuty: P2

sam: seeing it, I'm oncall. investigating root cause now.

alex: FYI I just pushed a model-serving config 09:50 that increased concurrent workers on "/generate" — could be overload.

sam: copying logs now. can someone check LB 503s and nginx upstream timeouts? @josh can you grab LB health?

josh: pulling LB logs, 503 spikes line up with model hot-reload window. looks like a short kernel of failures 09:50-09:57.

sam: rolling back the recent config to previous worker_count and restarting worker pool. doing canary rollback on subset of nodes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: initiated rollback of inference-service config to v1.3.7 by sam. status: rolling.

maria: ping — if rollback works we should suppress duplicate alerts. also want an immediate customer-impact check: any errors surfaced to hosted customers?

sam: quick check of customer errors: 14 tenants saw brief 5xx errors, mostly in ap-southeast region. duration < 8 minutes for each. No data loss reported.

alex: confirmed config change had aggressive warmup that exhausted file descriptors on 2 nodes. fixed fd limits in new build, but rollback will reduce worker_count to safe defaults.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-01 opened. Priority: P2. Assigned: sam. Status: mitigation in progress.

sam: rollback finished on all canary nodes, monitoring additional metrics now (error_rate, lat_p50/90, connection drops).

josh: LB errors dropped to baseline after 3m post-rollback. GC and fd stats look normal.

maria: thanks. Sam — after we close this, we need a short post-incident action plan: alert tuning (dedupe & grouping), threshold review, dashboard for fd usage, and PD routing tweaks.

sam: agreed. quick mitigation notes: 1) rollback prevented further customer impact, 2) short spike affected <1% of requests, 3) root cause config change + missing system limit check.

alex: taking ownership of the build process fix (ensure proper ulimit & readiness probe). Will open PR with fix and tests.

maria: for the alert noise: we got 12 PD notifications for similar symptoms across zones. We should dedupe at source and group by alert fingerprint (service + region + rule). Also consider a short alert hold window to avoid flapping.

sam: proposed immediate tuning (we'll run as temp config for 48h):
```
- rule: inference_5xx_rate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-api\",code=~\"5..\"}[1m])) by (service, region)
  for: 3m   # current is 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    description: \"5xx rate > threshold for 3m\"
- dedupe: true
- group_by: [service, region]
- rate_limit: 5/min  # PD suppress to avoid >5 alerts per min from same fingerprint
```

sam: notes: raise 'for' to 3m (from 1m) to reduce transient noise, enable dedupe, and group_by region+service. Rate limit on PD to avoid repeated pages during rollout.

maria: :+1: sounds good for short-term. Also add a dashboard panel to show fd usage, worker_count, and readiness probe failures so we can correlate next time.

josh: I'll make a dashboard tile in grafana under team SRE -> inference with a panel for fd_max - fd_used, worker_count, restart_count.

alex: PR for build fix and an automated ulimit test will land in my repo. tagging @maria for review.

sam: action items and owners: alex - PR for build + test; josh - grafana dashboard; maria - update PD escalation policy to include dedupe and rate_limit; sam - draft postmortem and coordinate with support for customer comms.

maria: timeline: we want temp alert tuning in place within 1h, dashboard in 24h, config fix and release in next deploy (48h), and final alert rule regression tests in CI before next release.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-01 status updated: mitigation successful. root cause suspected: aggressive worker spawn + ulimit exhaustion.

sam: handing off follow-ups to @maria for next 8 hours. I'll be available if needed.

maria: taking handoff. I'll create the PD change request: set dedupe to fingerprint(service, region, rule), add 3m hold, and set PD rate limit to 1/min per fingerprint as default for infra noisy rules.

josh: question: do we want to implement dedupe at Prometheus alertmanager level or rely on PD's dedupe? I prefer Alertmanager grouping so we can suppress at source before webhooks.

maria: agree — Alertmanager grouping + PD fallback. Make grouping labels explicit. Add a suppression window for flapping alerts in alertmanager config.

alex: for the longer term, can we add an alert gating job that checks system limits before increasing worker_count? I'll open a follow-up RFC.

sam: closing incident thread once PRs and dashboard tasks are tracked in tickets. Good catch everyone.

ops-bot: ticket created: SRE-1124 \"Alert tuning + fd dashboard + build ulimit test\" assigned to sam,maria,alex,josh.

maria: closing notes: customer impact low but visible; mitigation successful; follow-ups prioritized. will write a short postmortem draft later today. :white_check_mark:
